entries.description: Leave something in water for a while.
Leave something in sun or wind until the water is gone.
Hit one hard thing against another.
Cut something with a sharp edge.
Break something apart along its grain or layers.
Twist or weave strands over and under each other.
Form a soft mass by hand.
Expose something to strong heat for a long time.
Heat something for long with little air.
Heat something until it becomes liquid.
